news.title: Germany Misses Gas Storage Target as Prices Soar
news.summary: Germany has missed its gas storage target for the start of winter. Now, the EU’s largest economy faces a difficult heating season as the European gas benchmark topped 100 euros per MWh last week and has stayed there since. Higher prices may turn out to be the smaller problem. A supply crunch would be worse. Every European Union member state has an obligation to secure enough natural gas ahead of winter to fill 80% of storage capacity. Germany has failed to do that, only filling its storage to about 61%. This is problematic because Germany…

analysis.summary: Germany missed its winter gas storage target at only 61% capacity amid soaring European natural gas prices.
analysis.rationale: While directly concerning natural gas, severe winter gas shortages and high prices can trigger gas-to-oil switching for heating and power, exerting upward price pressure on crude oil.

news.title: TotalEnergies Now Sees Oil Demand Peaking Between 2035 and 2040
news.summary: A year after forecasting that oil demand would keep rising until 2040, TotalEnergies has moved its peak forward to between 2035 and 2040, and says the Iran war could accelerate the energy transition. The company’s annual energy outlook, released on Monday, projects demand for petroleum products plateauing through the 2030s before a slow decline. analysis.summary: TotalEnergies brought forward its projected peak in global oil demand to between 2035 and 2040.
analysis.rationale: Anticipating an earlier peak and subsequent plateau or decline in oil consumption points to weaker long-term demand, creating downward pressure on crude oil prices.
